visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a digital screen capture of a Japanese Mahjong game interface. The Mahjong table is visible with various tiles discarded in the center. An anime-style female character avatar sits on the right side of the screen. The background of the table has a night-time cityscape theme under a crescent moon, presented in a clean, high-saturation graphic style. (2) Suddenly, a win is declared, and the screen transitions to a high-contrast animation of a stylized female character. She is dressed in a shiny black leather or latex bodysuit and has hair split into black and white halves. She strikes a pose holding a handgun while purple energy swirls around her body, accompanied by glowing visual effects. (3) The score calculation screen appears over the game table background. Text indicators show a 'Mangan' win worth 12,000 points. Various game statistics and specific scoring tiles are listed in a list-like layout. The lighting is bright and saturated with purple and pink glowing effects from the game's UI overlays. (4) A second win sequence is shown later in the video with similar visual elements. The game interface displays a new set of tiles and a different board state before another character animation sequence plays. The final score screen for this round indicates a 'Mangan' victory worth 8,000 points.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic background music with a steady rhythm starts, accompanied by the clean, sharp digital clicking sounds of Mahjong tiles being discarded. The mix is professionally balanced, with the music sitting just below the tactical sound effects, creating a focused gaming atmosphere without any external environmental noise. (2) A sudden, high-pitched digital chime sound effect rings out, immediately followed by an energetic female vocal declaration in Japanese. The voice has high pitch variability and clear articulation, signaling a significant game event. This is layered over a deep, resonant impact SFX that mimics a heavy physical blow or explosion. (3) A rapid sequence of jingling, metallic sound effects plays, representing the accumulation of points on the screen. These percussive transients are bright and sharp, punctuating the background music which continues to play at a consistent tempo. The audio exhibits high spectral brightness and excellent signal-to-noise ratio throughout the tally. (4) The sequence of the winning chime and the impactful character voice line repeats for a second victory. The female vocal exhibits a triumphant tone with high arousal, while the following explosion SFX provides a dramatic conclusion to the gameplay segment. The background music then fades out as the video ends.
